The explanation leaves distractor 1 (男子だけのチームではないと分かったから) unrefuted, and that is the most tempting of the three: the passage does say 男子だけのチームではないらしい, so a learner who misses the らしい reads it as something he 分かった. _README.md requires the explanation to say why each distractor fails.

verdicts.problem: Stem attributes to direct speech something the passage marks as hearsay. The passage puts two things in the brother's mouth with と言っていた (来月、学校に申し込む / みんなで海へ行こう) and marks the summer deadline with らしい (目的は夏までに取ることらしい). Asking 'ani wa ... to itte imasu ka' therefore points at content the brother is never quoted as saying, and it does so in the one lesson (les:n3-relato-07) whose subject is exactly そうだ / らしい / と言っていた. It also makes distractor 1 (来月のはじめまで) more tempting than it should be, since 来月 IS inside a と言っていた. The key (夏) stays uniquely correct, so this is a stem repair, not a re-authoring. The corrected stem drops the false attribution and mirrors the passage's own frame 目的は…取ること; re-checked clean on level/P1/P2/P3/P4, and its P1 footing gets stronger (目的, 取る, こと, めん all verbatim in the passage, against めん / 言っ before).

corrected.explanation: A terceira frase diz que a meta é conseguir a carteira até o verão. O mês que vem é quando ele se inscreve na autoescola, e a praia só vem depois, se der tudo certo.

Falar em voz alta e lembrar do que não conseguiu dizer são justamente as dificuldades que ele descreve em seguida, e escrever cinco palavras novas é a tarefa de hoje, não algo que ele apresente como avanço.

Pensar no que tem para fazer é coisa da manhã, o passeio de sábado é justamente de mãos dadas com o filho, não sozinho, e o que passa um atrás do outro no texto são os dias, não as tarefas do trabalho.

summary: 22 reviewed: 15 pass clean, 7 fix (a full corrected row is supplied for each), 0 reject. Every row was re-checked against its OWN gating lesson with SudachiPy on a COPY of db/corpus.sqlite (scripts/ingest/known_set.py PassageGate, plus the work file's known_sets and level_kanji_allowed): all 22 pass the shape guard, the W17 level-kanji rule, P1 aboutness, P2 gating-lesson kanji, P3 gating-lesson words and P4 not-scannable, with 0 violations, and no correct answer is printed verbatim in its passage. The checker was plant-tested BEFORE it was trusted (untaught kanji, untaught words written entirely in taught kanji, a stem with no lexical footing, and a verbatim correct answer were each caught), so a clean result here is a real result and not a silent no-op. Each question was then answered from the passage alone before its key was read: all 22 keys are correct and uniquely defensible, none is answerable from general knowledge, and none is answerable by scanning a verbatim span. One content fix, read:n3-relato-07-02, where the stem asked what the brother SAID about a fact the passage marks with a hearsay/inference ending, inside the very lesson that teaches that distinction. Six explanation-only fixes where the pt-BR left an attractive distractor unrefuted, against _README.md's rule that the explanation say why each distractor fails; the Japanese in those six is untouched. Every corrected row is a complete row and was re-run through the same gates clean.
